title: Professor Hoot — Ligne-Powered Animation Pilot
summary: Replace the tween-based Professor Hoot mascot with a rigged, state-driven Ligne character: new artboard authored code-first via ligne-cli, seven animation states (five parity + curious head-tilt and double wing-flap greeting), drop-in API parity behind the existing Mascot interface, lazy post-boot wasm activation with tween fallback and a precache/runtime-cache split, shipped as v1.15.0.
